newsitem.title: FINLAND: Nokia says tuner unit healthy business.
newsitem.headline: Nokia says tuner unit healthy business.

text.p: Nokia on Friday declined to specify the price it earned on the sale of a tuner factory, but said the business was healthy.
"We aren't telling the price but it was a healthy unit," Heikki Koskinen, president of Nokia multimedia terminals, told Reuters by telephone.

The divestment of the factory, which employs 96 people, was for Nokia a logical result of a strategy to focus its multimedia business, he said. "We are not in a strategy focusing on components. We prefer to escape from the manufacture of tuners."

Nokia sold the unit to Semi-Tech (Global) Ltd, the investment arm of Toronto-based Semi Tech Corporation, in a follow-on deal after selling its television manufacturing business to Semi-Tech last year.
Koskinen said Semi-Tech needed the tuners in the television business. Nokia said in a statement it would continue to develop tuners for multimedia purposes.
